primary.title: Pollinator-mediated pollen transfer and floral longevity in Penstemon digitalis
primary.README_semantics: Different flowers and plants were sampled among treatments and floral days. Flowers sampled in separate experiments were not necessarily sampled from same plants.
primary.original_paper_explicit_limitation: Distinct sets of plants for pollen vs seed experiments; no direct relationship between stigma pollen deposition and seeds per flower can be inferred.
primary.original_paper_svd_result: A single-visit-deposition experimental cross produced no fruit; direct one-visit P→recruitment is not observed here.
primary.original_paper_prior_art: Floral longevity and two female-phase receptive days buffer temporally variable early-spring bee visitation; authors already reported this.

quality_gates.why: Primary manuscript and Dryad README explicitly distinguish independently sampled/destructively collected stigma pollen experiments from seed production experimental plants; matching by Day/Year or species alone cannot recover a same flower.
quality_gates.next_use: Existing published temporal floral-longevity/bee-visit effectiveness as independent prior-art ecological mechanism, not third matched mother/flower QPF prediction programme.
